The '''Sunrunner landspeeder''' was a civilian vehicle produced by [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]]. An armored variant, the [[Sunrunner zX landspeeder]], was later developed for use by militias and [[Planetary Security Forces]], particularly in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sunrunner landspeeder was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
